p: went to Shechem: After the death of Solomon.
made our yoke grievous: That is, handled us rudely, it seems that God hardened their hearts, so that they murmured without cause, which declares also the inconstancy of the people.
stood before him: Or, that stood by him, that is, which were of his counsel and secrets.
little finger shall be thicker than: Or, little finger, meaning that he was of far greater power than his father was.

cause was of God: God's will overrides all so that nothing can be done but according to the same, and yet man's will works by itself, so that he cannot use the excuse that his deed was of God's ordinance.
